'''Giovanni Ruvolo''' (born 8 May 1966 in Caltanissetta) is an Italian biologist and politician.<ref name=interior/>

He ran for Mayor of [[Caltanissetta]] as an [[Independent politician|independent]] at the [[2014 Italian local elections]] and he was elected on 11 June 2014.<ref name=interior/><ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.repubblica.it/static/speciale/2014/elezioni/comunali/caltanissetta.html|title=Elezioni comunali 2014 - Comune di Caltanissetta|publisher=[[la Repubblica]]|date=9 June 2014|language=it|access-date=14 March 2019}}</ref>
